items.headline: EPFO mandatory wage ceiling badha, ₹25,000 hua
items.what: Central Cabinet ne EPFO ki mandatory coverage ki wage ceiling ₹15,000 se badha kar ₹25,000 kar di hai. Isse zyada karmachaari ab cover honge.
items.who: Woh sab employers jin par EPFO laagu hota hai aur employees jinki salary ab ₹25,000 tak hai.
items.action: EPF salary compliance update karein. HR, payroll team ko calculation aur coverage mein badlaav laana hoga.

items.headline: Income Tax Forms 169, 171 revise hue, registration deadline badhi
items.what: CBDT ne Income Tax ke liye Forms 169, 171 revise kiye hain aur registration ki deadline extend ki hai. Naye rule se updated compliance zaroori hai.
items.who: Woh taxpayers jinhe ye forms bharne hain, ya nayi registration chahiye.
items.action: Naye forms download karein aur deadline ke andar registration/filing complete karein.

items.headline: 3,670+ MSME vendor development programme ka fayda
items.what: Ab tak 3,670 se zyada MSMEs ko vendor development programme ka fayda mil chuka hai, yeh Minister Mathan Raja ne bataya.
items.who: Jo MSMEs sarkari vendor development events mein shaamil hue hain ya hone wale hain.
items.action: Agar vendor development mein shaamil hona hai, sarkari portal ya office se registration kar lein.

items.headline: Gujarat Labour Code Rules 2025-26 ke liye checklist
items.what: Gujarat ne Labour Code Rules, 2025–26 release kiye hain, jiske liye compliance checklist bhi di gayi hai.
items.who: Sab employers aur HR jo Gujarat mein units chalate hain.
items.action: Di hui compliance checklist ko dekhein aur rules follow karein. Labour law documents update karein.

items.headline: Emami Paper Mills ko Rs 2.60 crore GST notice mila
items.what: GST department ne Emami Paper Mills ko Rs 2.60 crore ka demand notice issue kiya hai.
items.who: Emami Paper Mills aur GST registered manufacturing companies Odisha mein.
items.action: Jinke upar notice aaye, woh turant GST department se sampark karein, proper response file karein.

items.headline: J&K mein 29 State Tax Inspectors ka transfer-posting order
items.what: Jammu Kashmir ke Finance Department ne State Tax aur Excise Inspectors ke transfer aur posting ka order jaari kiya hai.
items.who: Jitne bhi affected Inspectors aur unki reporting authorities J&K State Tax/Excise mein hain.
items.action: Naye transfer order follow karein. Posting par turant join karein ya relieve hoon.

items.headline: GST evasion par crackdown hua, 7.56 crore recover kiye
items.what: Kerala sarkar ne GST evasion (chori) par action le kar 7.56 crore tax ki recovery ki hai.
items.who: Kerala mein business karne wale traders aur GST taxpayers.
items.action: Sabhi apni GST compliance check karein. Bina invoice ya under-reporting se bachein.

items.headline: GST on MDR issue GST Council ke samne ja sakta hai
items.what: GST Council ke samne MDR (Merchant Discount Rate) par GST lagu hone ka mudda aane ki sambhavna hai. Yeh digital payments aur UPI ecosystem ko effect kar sakta hai.
items.who: Digital payments aur UPI accept karne wale merchants.
items.action: Jo bhi GST/MDR pe effect ho sakta hai, GSTN notification ka intezar karein. Abhi current compliance follow karein.
